item.title: Only 160 apprenticeship starts in eight months on Labour’s flagship scheme
item.description: Exclusive: Government warned ‘skills revolution’ at risk amid slow start to project with target of 30,000 starts by end of parliament Labour has been warned its “skills revolution” to tackle youth unemployment risks failure, after its flagship apprenticeship scheme enrolled only 160 young people in its first eight months. The shortfall, highlighted in a report by the Fabian Society, leaves the government well off track of achieving its ambition of 30,000 “foundation apprenticeship” starts by the end of this parliament. item.title: Putin-backed United Russia leads Duma polls at 57.5% as Ukraine war looms
item.description: The three-day parliamentary election ended on Sunday, with the final results expected by September 25. Early figures released by Russia's Central Election Commission showed United Russia well ahead of other parties. The election is the first parliamentary vote since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. United Russia won 324 of the 450 seats in the State Duma in the previous parliamentary election in 2021. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: La carrera por el poder de los Bolsonaro se vuelca en el sur de Brasil
item.description: Flávio no es el único que hace campaña a la sombra de su padre en la familia Bolsonaro. Al hijo mayor, actualmente en una reñida disputa con el mandatario Lula da Silva por la Presidencia de Brasil, se unen sus hermanos Carlos y Renan, candidatos al Senado y a la Cámara de Diputados federal, , respectivamente, por Santa Catarina, en el sur de Brasil. En este territorio fiel al líder ultraderechista Jair Bolsonaro, su mero apellido parece bastar para ganar. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Macron, Carney hail new chapter in France-Canada ties at symbolic archipelago meeting
item.description: French President ​Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on ​Sunday called for stronger bilateral ties in the face of new global threats at a meeting on Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French territory off Canada's Newfoundland. The first-ever visit by a Canadian leader to the North Atlantic archipelago came as both countries have increasingly awkward relations with the US. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
item.description: Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with US The leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast. The two leaders’ visit to Saint-Pierre ​and Miquelon – the first by a French president since 2014 and the first by a Canadian prime minister – came just weeks ⁠after Donald Trump posted an image showing the islands, as well as all of Canada and other… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Former WTO head Pascal Lamy on the EU’s China choice: get a rebalance, or go protectionist
item.description: Pascal Lamy served two consecutive terms as director general of the World Trade Organization from 2005 to 2013. Before that, he spent decades in various French government roles, contributing to the building of the European Union. He was chief of staff to European Commission president Jacques Delors from 1985 to 1994, and European trade commissioner from 1999 to 2004. Here, he discusses Europe’s trade tensions with China, the continent’s growth potential problem and the WTO’s need for stronger... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Putin consolida su poder en las urnas
item.description: Victoria tranquila para Rusia Unida (RU). No hubo ninguna sorpresa en las urnas y el partido del oficialismo consiguió mantener su mayoría en la Duma, el Parlamento del gigante euroasiático. Con un 52,27% de los votos escrutados, la formación liderada por Vladímir Putin registraba al cierre de esta edición más del 57,84% de apoyos. El segundo en la lista era el Partido Comunista de la Federación Rusa con un 13,74%.El resultado era previsible. item.description: Russia vowed on Sunday to “intensify” its strikes on Kyiv in response to Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow, as an exit poll showed the ruling United Russia party on course to win tightly controlled parliamentary elections. Ukraine fired waves of drones at Moscow and the surrounding region on the final day of voting, killing two people and setting an oil refinery ablaze, officials said. item.title: Does Trump’s new AI Force signal tech race escalation ahead of Xi Jinping summit?
item.description: US President Donald Trump has unveiled a new “AI Force” just days ahead of a state visit by Chinese leader Xi Jinping, in a potential escalation of the high-stakes technology race between the rival powers. Experts said the proposed AI Force – whose exact structure remains unclear – could give Beijing a clear counterpart for AI safety talks, but warned it risked becoming an instrument of further technological containment and export controls targeting China. In a social media post on Saturday,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
